blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Chapter Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解密封品質測試 (Seal Quality Tests) 與洩漏測試 (Leak Tests) 的根本差異與互補關係
blocks.en: Understand the fundamental differences and complementary relationship between seal quality tests and leak tests

blocks.zh: 掌握五種密封品質測試技術的原理、適用包裝類型與關鍵參數
blocks.en: Master the principles, applicable package types and key parameters of the five seal quality test technologies

blocks.zh: 理解密封品質測試為何是「資格確認 (Qualification)」而非「完整驗証 (Full Validation)」
blocks.en: Understand why seal quality testing calls for "qualification" rather than "full validation"

blocks.zh: 了解殘余密封力 (RSF) 在玻璃小瓶軋蓋製程控制中的應用
blocks.en: Understand the use of residual seal force (RSF) in controlling the crimping process for glass vials

blocks.zh: 能為特定包裝系統選擇適當的密封品質測試，並理解其局限性
blocks.en: Be able to select an appropriate seal quality test for a given package system and understand its limitations

blocks.zh: 在 CCI 整體策略中正確定位密封品質測試——作為洩漏測試的補充，而非替代
blocks.en: Position seal quality testing correctly within the overall CCI strategy: as a complement to leak testing, not a replacement

blocks.en: Section 1 — Introduction: Seal Quality Tests vs. Leak Tests

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：密封品質測試的本質
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Nature of Seal Quality Testing

blocks.zh: 密封品質測試是「製程一致性的代理指標」，而非直接的完整性証明。邏輯鏈：
blocks.en: Seal quality testing is a surrogate indicator of process consistency, not direct proof of integrity. The logic chain:

blocks.zh: 密封品質一致 → 製程可控 → 產品-包裝系統大概率完整
blocks.en: Consistent seal quality → process under control → product-package system is very likely intact

blocks.zh: 但「密封品質好」≠「無洩漏」（例如：瓶身穿刺缺陷不在密封區域）
blocks.en: But "good seal quality" ≠ "no leak" (for example, a puncture defect on the container body is not in the seal area)

blocks.zh: 「密封品質差」也可能通過洩漏測試（早期剛剛密封，洩漏尚未明顯）
blocks.en: "Poor seal quality" may also pass a leak test (a freshly made seal may not yet show obvious leakage)

blocks.zh: 因此，兩類測試在時間和空間上互補，缺一不可。
blocks.en: The two types of test therefore complement each other in time and in space, and neither can be dispensed with.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：資格確認 vs. 完整驗証
blocks.en: Key Point: Qualification vs. Full Validation

blocks.zh: USP 對密封品質測試的要求是「資格確認 (Qualification)」，而非洩漏測試的「完整驗証 (Full Validation)」。
blocks.en: USP asks for "qualification" of seal quality tests, not the "full validation" required of leak tests.

blocks.zh: 資格確認：証明儀器工作正常、對該包裝系統設定適當 → 相對輕量
blocks.en: Qualification: demonstrates that the instrument works properly and is set up appropriately for the package system → relatively light effort

blocks.zh: 完整驗証：証明方法能可靠偵測到 MALL 附近的洩漏 → 需要大量陽性/陰性對照品數據
blocks.en: Full validation: demonstrates that the method can reliably detect leaks near the MALL → requires extensive positive/negative control data

blocks.zh: 這一區別對文件要求有直接影響——密封品質測試的 SOP 不需要達到 USP〈1225〉方法驗証的完整要求。
blocks.en: This distinction has a direct impact on documentation: the SOP for a seal quality test does not need to meet the full requirements for method validation under USP <1225>.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 密封品質測試就像汽車生產線上的「扭力扳手」——確保每顆螺絲都按規定扭矩鎖緊。扭矩正確通常意味著連接穩固，但不能保証螺紋本身沒有缺陷。真正的完整性確認（洩漏測試）就像事後用水壓測試整個系統。兩者結合才能確保品質。
blocks.en: Seal quality testing is like the torque wrench on an automobile assembly line: it makes sure every bolt is tightened to the specified torque. Correct torque usually means a secure joint, but it cannot guarantee that the threads themselves are free of defects. True integrity confirmation (a leak test) is like pressure-testing the whole system with water afterwards. Only the two together assure quality.

blocks.zh: Sections 2 & 3 — Closure Torque & Package Burst 閉合扭矩與包裝爆破
blocks.en: Sections 2 & 3 — Closure Torque & Package Burst

blocks.zh: 重點提示：爆破測試無法証明完整性
blocks.en: Key Point: Burst Testing Cannot Prove Integrity

blocks.zh: USP 明確指出：爆破測試無法提供密封均勻性或整體包裝完整性的資訊。一個能承受高爆破壓力的包裝，仍可能在密封區域之外（如包裝面破損）洩漏。爆破測試主要用於：
blocks.en: USP states explicitly that burst testing does not provide information on seal uniformity or overall package integrity. A package that withstands a high burst pressure may still leak outside the seal area (for example, through damage to the package face). Burst testing is mainly used to:

blocks.zh: 確認密封製程的最低強度要求
blocks.en: Confirm the minimum strength requirement of the sealing process

blocks.zh: 比較不同密封參數下的密封強度
blocks.en: Compare seal strength under different sealing parameters

blocks.zh: 模擬運輸或滅菌過程中的壓差挑戰
blocks.en: Simulate pressure-differential challenges during transport or sterilization

blocks.zh: 包裝爆破測試就像測試氣球能充多少氣才爆——知道了「爆破壓力」，但不知道氣球表面是否有微小針孔。高爆破壓力說明密封接頭夠牢固，但針孔在任何壓力下都會慢慢洩氣。這就是為什麼爆破測試必須與洩漏測試搭配使用。
blocks.en: Package burst testing is like testing how much air a balloon can hold before it pops: you learn the burst pressure, but not whether the balloon surface has a tiny pinhole. A high burst pressure shows that the seal joint is strong, but a pinhole will let air out slowly at any pressure. This is why burst testing must be paired with leak testing.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼多劑量容器（如眼藥水）的扭矩規格設定需要特別考慮終端使用者的開瓶力量？這與單劑量容器有何不同？
blocks.en: Why does setting the torque specification for a multi-dose container (such as eye drops) need to take the end user's opening force into account? How does this differ from a single-dose container?

blocks.zh: ASTM F2054（有限位板）和 ASTM F1140（無限位板）的爆破測試各適合用於什麼場景？
blocks.en: For which scenarios are burst tests per ASTM F2054 (with restraining plates) and ASTM F1140 (without restraining plates) each suited?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：扭矩測試的雙面刃
blocks.en: Core Concept: Torque Testing Cuts Both Ways

blocks.zh: 應用扭矩過高（Over-torque）和過低（Under-torque）都有問題：
blocks.en: Both over-torque and under-torque are problematic:

blocks.zh: 因此，設定扭矩規格必須考慮整個貨架期的應力鬆弛，不只是剛組裝時的數值。
blocks.en: The torque specification must therefore take stress relaxation over the whole shelf life into account, not just the value at the time of assembly.

blocks.zh: Sections 4 & 5 — Package Seal Strength & Residual Seal Force 包裝密封強度與殘余密封力
blocks.en: Sections 4 & 5 — Package Seal Strength & Residual Seal Force

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：剝離測試的兩個數值
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Two Values from a Peel Test

blocks.zh: 剝離測試提供兩個有用的數值：
blocks.en: A peel test provides two useful values:

blocks.zh: 最大密封力 (Maximum Seal Force)：密封接頭開始破裂時的峰值力 → 反映密封強度
blocks.en: Maximum seal force: the peak force at which the seal joint begins to fail → reflects seal strength

blocks.zh: 平均開封力 (Average Peel Force)：整個剝離過程的平均力 → 反映密封均勻性
blocks.en: Average peel force: the average force over the whole peeling process → reflects seal uniformity

blocks.zh: 一致的平均剝離力分布（沒有突然下降）表明密封均勻，製程穩定。突然下降可能提示局部通道缺陷 (channel defect)。
blocks.en: A consistent average peel force profile (with no sudden drops) indicates a uniform seal and a stable process. A sudden drop may point to a local channel defect.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：RSF 的物理意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Physical Meaning of RSF

blocks.zh: RSF 衡量的是膠塞被壓入瓶口後，膠塞對瓶口施加的殘余壓縮力。這個力是維持密封的來源：
blocks.en: RSF measures the residual compressive force that the stopper exerts on the vial neck after it has been pressed into the neck finish. This force is what maintains the seal:

blocks.zh: RSF 太低 → 膠塞對瓶口施力不足 → 密封力下降 → 洩漏風險增加
blocks.en: RSF too low → insufficient force from the stopper on the vial → reduced seal force → higher risk of leakage

blocks.zh: RSF 太高 → 可能膠塞過度壓縮 → 長期材料疲勞 → 密封失效
blocks.en: RSF too high → the stopper may be over-compressed → long-term material fatigue → seal failure

blocks.zh: RSF 是軋蓋製程的直接監控指標，與軋蓋力 (capping force) 設定密切相關，常用於製程驗証中的過程能力分析 (Cpk)。
blocks.en: RSF is a direct monitoring indicator for the crimping process and is closely tied to the capping force setting. It is commonly used for process capability analysis (Cpk) in process validation.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — RSF 曲線解讀
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Interpreting the RSF Curve

blocks.zh:
RSF 測試的應力-時間曲線形態：

 力 (N)
  |           /\    ← 最大壓縮力
  |          /  \
  |         /    \__________ ← 平台段 = RSF值
  |________/
  |________________________ 時間 (s)
          ↑
    「斜率突然改變」的轉折點 = RSF 讀取點

RSF 的讀取：在應力-形變曲線中
「末端斜率改變之前的點」= 膠塞被進一步壓縮前的殘余力

鋁蓋塑料頂蓋在測試前通常需要移除
以獲得更可重現的結果
blocks.en:
Shape of the stress-time curve in an RSF test:

 Force (N)
  |           /\    ← maximum compression force
  |          /  \
  |         /    \__________ ← plateau = RSF value
  |________/
  |________________________ Time (s)
          ↑
    Inflection point where "the slope suddenly changes" = RSF reading point

Reading the RSF: on the stress-deformation curve,
the "point before the slope changes at the end" = residual force before the stopper is compressed further

The plastic flip-off cap of the aluminum seal is normally removed before testing
to obtain more reproducible results

blocks.zh: 重點提示：RSF 的監管應用
blocks.en: Key Point: Regulatory Use of RSF

blocks.zh: RSF 在無菌小瓶灌裝的法規文件中具有重要地位：
blocks.en: RSF has an important place in the regulatory documentation for aseptic vial filling:

blocks.zh: 軋蓋製程驗証：需建立 RSF 的合格範圍（通常以 N 或 lbf 表示）
blocks.en: Crimping process validation: an acceptable RSF range must be established (usually expressed in N or lbf)

blocks.zh: 軋蓋機 IQ/OQ/PQ：RSF 作為關鍵輸出參數被監控
blocks.en: Capper IQ/OQ/PQ: RSF is monitored as a critical output parameter

blocks.zh: 日常製造監控：每批可抽樣測量 RSF 以確認製程一致性
blocks.en: Routine manufacturing monitoring: RSF can be measured on samples from each batch to confirm process consistency

blocks.zh: FDA 483 觀察中有涉及「未對膠塞壓縮力進行充分控制」的案例
blocks.en: There are FDA 483 observations citing "inadequate control of stopper compression force"

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 承接新客戶的瓶裝凍乾產品時，軋蓋製程驗証通常包括：(1) 不同軋蓋力設定下的 RSF 數值 → 建立 RSF 與軋蓋力的相關性曲線；(2) 同時進行 CCI 測試（如真空衰減），確認 RSF 值在什麼範圍時包裝 CCI 合格；(3) 以此設定生產中的 RSF 規格（上下限），作為軋蓋製程的 IPT 指標。
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on a new client's lyophilized vial product, crimping process validation typically includes: (1) RSF values at different capping force settings → establishing a correlation curve between RSF and capping force; (2) CCI testing in parallel (such as vacuum decay) to confirm the RSF range within which the package passes CCI; (3) using this to set the in-production RSF specification (upper and lower limits) as an IPT indicator for the crimping process.

blocks.zh: Section 6 — Airborne Ultrasound 空氣耦合超音波
blocks.en: Section 6 — Airborne Ultrasound

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：超音波密封檢測的物理原理
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Physics of Ultrasonic Seal Inspection

blocks.zh: 空氣耦合超音波的工作原理：
blocks.en: How airborne ultrasound works:

blocks.zh: 好的密封：兩層材料緊密熔合，超音波可以從發射端穿越密封區域到達接收端 → 信號強
blocks.en: Good seal: the two material layers are tightly fused, so the ultrasound can travel from the transmitter across the seal area to the receiver → strong signal

blocks.zh: 有缺陷的密封：通道、皺摺、異物夾入 → 密封區域有空隙 → 超音波被空氣衰減或反射 → 信號弱
blocks.en: Defective seal: channels, wrinkles or trapped foreign matter → voids in the seal area → ultrasound is attenuated or reflected by air → weak signal

blocks.zh: 「空氣耦合 (Airborne)」是指超音波在空氣中傳播，不需要液體或凝膠作為耦合介質（不同於傳統接觸式超音波探傷）。
blocks.en: "Airborne" (air-coupled) means the ultrasound travels through air and needs no liquid or gel as a coupling medium (unlike conventional contact ultrasonic flaw detection).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：超音波密封測試的應用邊界
blocks.en: Key Point: Application Boundaries of Ultrasonic Seal Testing

blocks.zh: 超音波密封測試的重要限制：
blocks.en: Important limitations of ultrasonic seal testing:

blocks.zh: 不能偵測：密封區域以外的包裝完整性問題（如袋面穿刺）
blocks.en: Cannot detect: package integrity problems outside the seal area (such as punctures in the pouch face)

blocks.zh: 不能定量：洩漏速率或缺陷大小無法量化
blocks.en: Cannot quantify: leak rate or defect size cannot be quantified

blocks.zh: 影響因素多：材料紋理、厚度、掃描速度都會影響信號基準值的建立
blocks.en: Many influencing factors: material texture, thickness and scan speed all affect the establishment of the signal baseline

blocks.zh: 在凍乾托盤密封 (tray sealing) 的品質監控中有良好應用——可快速掃描大面積密封
blocks.en: Works well for quality monitoring of tray sealing for lyophilized products, because large seal areas can be scanned quickly

blocks.zh: 空氣耦合超音波就像在牆的一側對著密封處說話，另一側的人聽聲音大小。如果牆壁（密封）完整，聲音清晰；如果牆上有縫隙（通道缺陷），聲音就會被吸收或改變。這項技術特別適合發現「通道缺陷」——剝離測試可能會錯過極細微的通道，但超音波可以精確掃描到。
blocks.en: Airborne ultrasound is like speaking toward the seal from one side of a wall while someone on the other side listens to how loud it is. If the wall (the seal) is intact, the sound is clear; if there is a gap in the wall (a channel defect), the sound is absorbed or altered. The technique is especially good at finding channel defects: a peel test may miss very fine channels, but ultrasound can scan them out precisely.

blocks.zh: 空氣耦合超音波密封測試被描述為「非破壞性」，但它是密封品質測試，不是洩漏測試。如果超音波掃描顯示密封區域完好，能否據此確認包裝不洩漏？請說明原因。
blocks.en: Airborne ultrasound seal testing is described as "non-destructive", but it is a seal quality test, not a leak test. If an ultrasound scan shows the seal area to be intact, can you conclude that the package does not leak? Explain why.

blocks.zh: 對於一個含鋁箔層的軟袋包裝（如 IV 袋），超音波密封測試適用嗎？和 HVLD 相比，各有什麼優勢？
blocks.en: Is ultrasonic seal testing suitable for a flexible pouch containing an aluminum foil layer (such as an IV bag)? What are the respective advantages compared with HVLD?

blocks.zh: 在無菌軟袋灌裝（如大容量輸液袋）的品質體系中，超音波密封測試是理想的在線製程監控工具：可在灌裝線上即時掃描每個袋子的密封區域，立即發現熱封不均勻、通道缺陷等製程異常，並觸發線上剔除或停線警報。配合定期抽樣的 CCI 洩漏測試（如真空衰減），形成完整的包裝完整性保障體系。
blocks.en: In the quality system for aseptic flexible bag filling (such as large-volume infusion bags), ultrasonic seal testing is an ideal in-line process monitoring tool: it can scan the seal area of every bag in real time on the filling line, immediately detect process abnormalities such as uneven heat sealing and channel defects, and trigger in-line rejection or a line-stop alarm. Combined with periodic sampling for CCI leak testing (such as vacuum decay), it forms a complete package integrity assurance system.

blocks.zh: 技術比較總覽 Technology Comparison Summary
blocks.en: Technology Comparison Summary

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 密封品質測試 ≠ 洩漏測試：前者是製程控制的代理指標，後者直接測量包裝完整性；兩者互補，缺一不可
blocks.en: Seal quality test ≠ leak test: the former is a surrogate indicator for process control, while the latter directly measures package integrity; the two complement each other and neither can be omitted

blocks.zh: 資格確認即可：密封品質測試只需資格確認（儀器性能 + 設定適當性），不需完整的分析方法驗証
blocks.en: Qualification is sufficient: seal quality tests need only qualification (instrument performance plus suitability of the setup), not full analytical method validation

blocks.zh: 五種技術各有定位：扭矩（螺旋蓋）→ 爆破（軟袋強度）→ 剝離（密封均勻性）→ RSF（玻璃瓶軋蓋）→ 超音波（密封區域缺陷定位）
blocks.en: Each of the five technologies has its own role: torque (screw caps) → burst (flexible pouch strength) → peel (seal uniformity) → RSF (glass vial crimping) → ultrasound (locating defects in the seal area)

blocks.zh: RSF 是無菌小瓶的核心：與軋蓋力線性相關，是軋蓋製程驗証和日常監控的標準工具，在 PDA TR27 和 USP〈1207.3〉中均有依據
blocks.en: RSF is central to aseptic vials: it correlates linearly with capping force and is the standard tool for crimping process validation and routine monitoring, with a basis in both PDA TR27 and USP <1207.3>

blocks.zh: 超音波的獨特優勢：非接觸、非破壞、可在線、可定位缺陷——是軟袋灌裝線在線品質監控的理想選擇
blocks.en: The unique strengths of ultrasound: non-contact, non-destructive, usable in-line, and able to locate defects, making it an ideal choice for in-line quality monitoring on flexible bag filling lines

blocks.zh: 密封品質測試無法証明完整性：通過任何密封品質測試的包裝，仍可能因為密封區域以外的缺陷（穿刺、裂縫）而洩漏，這是密封品質測試的根本局限性
blocks.en: Seal quality tests cannot prove integrity: a package that passes any seal quality test may still leak through defects outside the seal area (punctures, cracks); this is the fundamental limitation of seal quality testing

blocks.zh: USP〈1207〉三章整體：〈1207.1〉選方法 + 〈1207.2〉洩漏技術 + 〈1207.3〉密封品質技術 = CCI 完整知識體系，三者結合才能構建科學合理的包裝完整性保障計劃
blocks.en: The three USP <1207> chapters as a whole: <1207.1> method selection + <1207.2> leak technologies + <1207.3> seal quality technologies = a complete CCI body of knowledge; only the three combined can build a scientifically sound package integrity assurance program
